summary: Implemented conservative TP root-only logits gather for ordinary, eager, non-speculative generation. TP rank 0 samples the gathered logits and broadcasts token IDs before every rank updates decode state. Existing all-gather behavior is retained for logprob, prefill-only, speculative, DP-attention, attention-TP, TP-LM-head all-to-all, CUDA graph replay, and graph capture paths.

tests.what_was_measured: 10 unit tests covering gather eligibility, five compatibility fallbacks, graph-capture exclusion, root-only sampling, non-root None-logits safety, token broadcast, and adjacent decode-row regression behavior. Raw output: /job/repo/reports/j-eed1a3506b39/raw/unit-final.log
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, spelling, registered-test policy, and safety hooks. Raw output: /job/repo/reports/j-eed1a3506b39/raw/precommit.log

tests.command: two-rank Gloo exercise of GroupCoordinator.gather followed by GroupCoordinator.broadcast
tests.what_was_measured: Actual collective semantics: rank 0 received [[1,2,3,4]], rank 1 received None, and both ranks received sampled token IDs [3,1]. Raw output: /job/repo/reports/j-eed1a3506b39/raw/cpu_distributed_collective.log

tests.command: single-GPU deterministic sharded-vocabulary projection compared with an independent full torch.nn.functional.linear reference
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, concatenated two-way vocabulary shards had max_abs_error=0.0 and identical argmax tokens to the independent full projection. Raw output: /job/repo/reports/j-eed1a3506b39/raw/gpu_numerical.log

gpu_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) executed the numerical vocabulary-shard/reference comparison; output is retained at /job/repo/reports/j-eed1a3506b39/raw/gpu_numerical.log.
remaining_limitations: Only one GPU was assigned and visible, so a real multi-GPU RCCL gather/broadcast serving run and communication-performance comparison could not be executed.
CUDA graph capture/replay retains all-gather because torch.distributed.gather is not safely graph-capturable across supported backends; eager decode and ordinary extend generation use gather.

Speculative decoding, return-logprob, prefill-only, DP-attention, attention-TP, and TP-LM-head all-to-all paths intentionally retain all-gather because ranks may independently consume logits or use different communication layouts.
No model-weight HTTP serving fixture was used: the available tiny fixture cannot validate a distributed TP workload, and transport/startup evidence would not qualify this feature.
No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
